description: Header file defining the WarningReportingUnit class and nested Setting class, including JSON serialization, category management, and warning event reporting for warning reporting system.

classes.name: WarningReportingUnit
classes.description: Main class managing warning reporting categories and events.

classes.name: WarningReportingUnit::Setting
classes.description: Represents configuration settings for warning categories, including JSON serialization.

classes.name: WarningReportingUnit::Setting::JSON
classes.description: JSON container class for serializing and deserializing category settings.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Clones a warning reporting category by name.

methods.name: AddToCategoryList
methods.description: Adds a category control to the internal list.

methods.name: RemoveFromCategoryList
methods.description: Removes a category control from the internal list.

methods.name: GetCategories
methods.description: Returns a list of category names.

methods.name: FetchCategoryInformation
methods.description: Retrieves default and current enabled/disabled status, exclusions, and configuration for a category.

methods.name: Defaults
methods.description: Gets or sets default category configurations in JSON format.

methods.name: ReportWarningEvent
methods.description: Reports a warning event with an identifier and event information.

methods.name: UpdateEnabledCategories
methods.description: Updates internal enabled categories based on JSON configuration.
